last_sync.summary: The repository README now presents the public Capoworks ECU on-demand firmware builder, including how to sign in, select a board, choose opt-in modules and table dimensions, download the matching firmware image and generated TunerStudio INI, and the limit of six builds per user per day. The existing on-demand firmware build wiki page is updated to describe the public builder alongside the manual workflow, with the same profile rules, artifact pairing, and safety boundaries.

decisions.rationale: The repository README now advertises the public Capoworks ECU on-demand firmware builder at capoworks.undo.it/firmware and adds a section describing the user flow: sign in, select a supported board, choose opt-in modules and table dimensions, then download the matching firmware image and generated TunerStudio INI. It also states a limit of six builds per user per day. The on-demand firmware build wiki page is updated so readers can use the public builder as well as the manual GitHub Actions workflow, while keeping the same profile rules, the requirement to treat firmware and INI as one matching pair, and the warning that a successful build is not engine or hardware validation.
